capabilities: Open any local video file in a dedicated player panel
Insert human-readable timestamp links at the current playback position
Capture the current frame as a PNG screenshot into the attachments folder
Jump the player to an exact second when a timestamp link is clicked
Control playback (play/pause, seek) via commands and hotkeys
disambiguation: Only works on video files stored in the vault; it does not support YouTube or streaming video.
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases.
intentEvidence: Inspired by media-extended, minus every online feature
motivation: The author wanted media-extended's local-video note-taking without any online features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to take timestamped notes on local video files or jump from a note back to an exact playback moment.

relations.evidence: Inspired by media-extended, minus every online feature

summary: Offline plugin that plays local vault videos and inserts human-readable timestamp links, frame screenshots, and hotkey playback controls.
